question: Does product-tree batch inversion preserve exact outputs while reducing source-level field multiplications, and what do matched GPU stage diagnostics show?

claims.text: Native product-tree normalization preserves canonical outputs, deterministic relation witnesses and independent CPU replay on all fixed fixtures.
Native tree uses fewer source-level normalization multiplications than the previous dual scan on these fixed block sizes, excluding the shared inversion and affine conversion.
Certified latency speedup, fastest-tool status, full ECDLP performance and asymptotic improvements are not established by this L0 diagnostic panel.

arms.description: Second invocation of the identical u binary

positive.not_applicable_reason: Two planted reachable targets per execution exercise the same GPU path and independent host witness verification; each must be detected.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Two fixed negative targets per execution are exhaustively checked by the independent host backend; no random-population claim is made.

factors.name: source_and_build
factors.how: Only the normalizer compile definition differs; record each binary hash.

factors.name: inputs
factors.value: p=2^61-1,a=0,b=7; base sizes16,64,256; 4slots; normalization counts257,65537,262145; seeds111,222,333
factors.how: Native deterministic generator independent of arm; CPU reference checks every witness and negative target.

factors.name: host
factors.how: Same full RTX PRO6000 and pod for all rows. Record device identity, GPU state, CPU affinity and CPUinfo; shared host earns only L0.

factors.name: memory_layout
factors.how: Fresh process each cell samples ASLR; allocations, launch geometry, row/chunk caps fixed.

factors.name: order
factors.how: Four-arm Latin rotation with alternating reversal per round and instance.

factors.name: analyst
factors.how: Frozen Rust analysis consumes neutral u/v/w/x labels and validates complete cells/digests; labels are decoded only in report.

seed_derivation.note: seed=111*(instance_index+1), all arms/rounds share deterministic inputs; SplitMix64 constructs projective scales.

instance_sampling.rule: Fixed public software fixtures, not random scientific population: three increasing base sizes and partial-block normalization sizes.

blinding.how: Standalone frozen analyzer receives only rows.csv with neutral u/v/w/x arm labels, no protocol or identity key. Numerical signatures may reveal implementations.

power.note: Exact source-level counts and deterministic equality need no sampling power. Nine repeats characterize descriptive ranges only; no timed significance test or equivalence claim.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Conservative unmeasured allocation estimate, not timing evidence. Round0 is the declared per-arm/size preflight and warmup; preserve all costs. No preflight numbers existed at freeze.

primary.name: Normalization multiplication count
primary.definition: Per invocation: padded blocks times4608 for dualscan or765 for tree. Excludes identical inversion/affine work; not total GAE or machine instructions. CUB count is omitted because implementation-dependent.

secondary.name: Normalization kernel diagnostic
secondary.definition: CUDA event interval over8 launches divided by8, after one untimed kernel launch; readback and verification excluded.
secondary.resolution: CUDA events approximately0.5us; host steady_clock reported milliseconds

secondary.name: Prepare diagnostic
secondary.definition: Host synchronized prepare including allocations, table build, sort and device sync.
secondary.resolution: CUDA events approximately0.5us; host steady_clock reported milliseconds

secondary.name: Four-query diagnostic
secondary.definition: Four device.find calls including transfers, synchronization and native witness verification; independent comparison checker outside interval.
secondary.resolution: CUDA events approximately0.5us; host steady_clock reported milliseconds

secondary.name: Cold pipeline diagnostic
secondary.definition: Fresh-process fixture construction, plan validation, GPU context initialization, prepare and four queries. Independent host cross-check excluded; no context reuse.
secondary.resolution: CUDA events approximately0.5us; host steady_clock reported milliseconds

placement.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

stopping_rules.rule: 4arms x3instances x(1warmup+9rounds)=120 rows; no extra repeats after viewing results.
Any incorrect output, failed sanitizer or missing cell invalidates the run; retain failures. Worker2400s/controller2700s deadline; delete pod and retain partial data.

invalidation_rules: Any output mismatch, nonzero sanitizer result, missing measured cell or source mismatch invalidates the panel.

decision_rule.text: C1 requires all correctness checks and identical cross-arm digests. C2 requires the exact native count765 perblock versus4608, with equality passing. Timing is L0 descriptive telemetry and cannot decide a speedup or fastest-tool claim.
decision_rule.threshold: all equality checks pass; candidate normalization_muls < baseline for every fixture
decision_rule.statistic: exact algorithmic multiplication count; descriptive latency median/min/max
decision_rule.interval: exact counts; diagnostic full observed range, no confidence interval
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: native multiplication count difference and ratio, excluding inversion/affine work

graphs: Per-arm four-query diagnostic latency with full ranges

inadmissible: Treating L0 clocks as certified speedups
Omitting prepare/context costs from a full-pipeline claim
Changing fixtures or repeat count after reading observations
Calling normalization counts total field work or GAE
Claiming CUB field counts without instrumentation

literature.claim: Work-efficient up/down tree traversal replaces redundant inclusive scans; shared-memory access can still dominate.
literature.verified_by: Primary chapter read before implementation,2026-10-30 UTC

literature.claim: CUDA launches are asynchronous; use event timing and explicit synchronization, report scope.
